_about: Public-domain Cardinal Reginald Pole (1500-1558), the last Catholic archbishop of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: A Treatie of Iustification found among his writings (Louvain, 1569) and his oration as translated by Fabyane Wythers (catalogued 1560), from Internet Archive scans of the early printed books. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

pole-treatie-justification-1569: A Treatie of Iustification, founde emong the writinges of Cardinal Pole (Lovanii: apud Ioannem Foulerum, 1569)

_alternates.pole-letters: Nine Historical Letters of the Reign of Henry VIII (T. Richards, catalogued 1871): four writers, so not shelved here
_alternates.pole-seditious-oration: The seditious and blasphemous oration of Cardinal Pole, tr. Fabyane Wythers (catalogued 1560): its title page is unreadable OCR, so it is not shelved

_excluded.pole-other: Starkey's Dialogue (Starkey's work); Lives by Phillips, Beccadelli, Lee, Haile and Gasquet; De Unitate in English (first 1965)

_rights_checked.pole-treatie-justification-1569: title page read: translator not named; the volume also translates the decree of Trent on justification and passages of Augustine, Chrysostom, Basil, Leo and Cyprian
